#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;
vector<long long> fac;

long long modpow(long long b, long long e) {
    long long res = 1;
    b %= MOD;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) res = res * b % MOD;
        b = b * b % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long ncr(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    long long num = fac[n];
    long long den = fac[n - r] * fac[r] % MOD;
    long long inv = modpow(den, MOD - 2);
    return num * inv % MOD;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    long long k;
    scanf("%d%lld", &n, &k);
    if (k > n - 1) {
        printf("0\n");
        return 0;
    }
    fac.resize(n + 1);
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * (i % MOD)) % MOD;
    }
    int pop = n - (int)k;
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= pop; i++) {
        long long notPop = ncr(pop, i) * modpow(pop - i, n) % MOD;
        if (i & 1) notPop = (MOD - notPop) % MOD;
        ans = (ans + notPop) % MOD;
    }
    ans = ans * ncr(n, pop) % MOD;
    if (k != 0) ans = ans * 2 % MOD;
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
